answer_1.quote: We tested our proposed approach on multiple document summarization benchmarks, including AGGREFACT-FTSOTA split, DIVER-SUMM, LONGSCIVERIFY, LONGEVAL, and a nonscientific domain dataset LEGALSUMM with a focus on long document summarization.

answer_2.quote: On LONGSCIVERIFY and LONGEVAL, we report Kendall's Tau τ, following ...; for AGGREFACT-FTSOTA, DIVERSUMM and LEGALSUMM, we adopt ROCAUC which measures classification performance with varied thresholds as our evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: We additionally include the GPT4o (OpenAI et al., 2024) as the LLM fact-checker, using a prompt adopted from Tang et al. (2024).

answer_4.quote: We conducted evaluations with two voluntary legal experts ... annotators are asked to select from four choices justifying the factual consistency of the model-generated summary with the reference summary and source article ... The annotation guideline is included in Figure .
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select from four factual consistency categories and provide free‑text rationales; guidelines detail how to judge relation, entity, circumstance, coreference, link, out‑of‑article, and grammatical errors.
